Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 37

“The Blessed Lord said: It is desire, it is anger, born of the quality of passion — all-devouring and greatly harmful. Know this to be the enemy here.”

Krishna names one culprit wearing two faces: desire, and the anger it becomes when blocked. All-devouring is the crucial charge — it has no point at which it is satisfied.
